Chapter 138 - 138 Lin Fan, You’Ve Worked Hard!

Chapter 138 - 138 Lin Fan, You’ve Worked Hard!

138 Lin Fan, You’ve Worked Hard!

The article by Sunshine Scholar was quickly noticed by Li Jing and the others.

As a result, they led a large number of fake reviewers and fans to like and share the post. Li Jing herself liked the post.

Instantly, the popularity soared.

Lonely Frog: [This is too miserable! So many people actually died!]

Author: [I saw an old man being stepped to death in the photo!]

Truth: [I’ve been wondering about this. There are so many big names in the United States and Germany, but none of them have invented an earthquake prediction device. How did a person in Hua Nation come out of nowhere and invent an earthquake prediction device?]

Nameless Man: [We people in Hua Nation have always been doing fake things like this. When will we be able to do the truth like the US and others? How many big shots do we really have here?]

Molala: [The universities here have been tainted a long time ago. I don’t find it strange at all that such a situation has occurred.]

Treasure: [Jing Jing and the victims are really too miserable!]

…

Not long after, Sunshine Scholar appeared on Weibo’s hot search list.

Chen Zhong looked at the rising number of views and fans, and his whole face almost burst into laughter.

At this moment, his phone vibrated slightly.

His American sponsor had sent him a message: [Today’s article was not bad. Continue to lead the conflict. I’ll give you a million yuan reward first.]

Then, Chen Zhong’s phone vibrated again.

[Notice from Huishang Bank: 1,000,000 yuan have been deposited into your account.]

Seeing this…

Chen Zhong was so happy that he directly jumped up.

Then, he placed his hands on the keyboard and began to type quickly again, preparing to publish another article.

…

In the Zhou family’s house in Jingbei.

Zhou Guotao carefully read the information in front of him.

After a while, he said, “So Lin Fan invented an earthquake prediction device that can predict earthquakes five days in advance. Furthermore, it has passed the review of all the experts in the Scientific Research Institute…

“But now, he’s being attacked online by an actress and some nobodies?”

Zhou Guotao’s tone was calm.

However, Zhou Shihong, who was standing at the side, understood that the old man was really angry.

The reason why Zhou Guotao was able to turn the Zhou family into one of the top four families by himself was because of his own power.

On one hand, it was because he was more capable than others.

On the other hand, it was because he loved his country and was loyal to it!

That was why Hua Nation dared to let him develop.

Now, Zhou Guotao heard someone defaming scientists, especially this scientist… It was Lin Fan!

One had to know that Lin Fan had saved his life before!

Zhou Guotao’s anger was obvious.

“It’s about time the entertainment industry is reorganized!” Zhou Guotao said in a low voice after a while.

…

Jingbei, the Qin family.

After Lin Fan’s grandfather’s birthday, Qin Weiming brought his grandson back to Jingbei.

At this moment, Qin Weiming was sitting leisurely on the armchair, shaking his body gently.

At this moment, a man with a badge on his shoulder walked over with a straight back.

“Lil Xu, what’s the matter?” Qin Weiming raised his eyes.

“Old Leader, Lin Fan has developed an earthquake prediction device that can predict earthquakes five days in advance,” Lil Xu said.

“Oh? Lin Fan is really something! He knows mathematics, has medical skills, and now he has even invented an earthquake prediction device! Good, good, good!”

Qin Weiming’s cloudy eyes lit up as he spoke, and he stood up.

Obviously, he was very happy to hear this news.

Back then, Qin Weiming rose up to resist because he did not want the people to suffer.

He could drive away the invaders.

However, natural disasters like earthquakes could not be driven away.

Therefore, every time an earthquake happened, Qin Weiming would be heartbroken.

Now, hearing that someone had invented an earthquake prediction device and one that could predict earthquakes five days in advance…

This would definitely greatly reduce the suffering of the people!

How could he not be happy?

Qin Weiming was happy, but he realized that Lil Xu seemed to have something to say. He could not help but ask, “What’s the matter? Is there anything else?”

“Also, the internet is attacking Lin Fan,” Lil Xu said.

Qin Weiming heard this and frowned.

Then, Lil Xu took out a stack of documents.

Qin Weiming quickly flipped through them…

The next moment, he slammed his palm on the armchair, and the back of the chair broke.

It was obvious how angry Qin Weiming was after reading the information.

“Very well! An actress and some nobodies publicly slandered a scientist who’s serving the country and the people? How dare they?!”

…

In the dim rental house.

Chen Zhong opened the backend again and looked at the rapidly rising view count and the number of followers. He could not help but stand up and shake his butt.

“I’m rich! I’m really rich this time!” He laughed.

At this moment, there was a dull knock on the door.

“Who is it?” Chen Zhong frowned.

“Express delivery!”

“Express delivery?” Chen Zhong muttered. “I don’t think I bought anything.”

Even though he was confused, he still opened the door.

Whoosh!

In the next moment, a large group of officers rushed in and shouted, “Squat down!”

“Hold your head!”

Chen Zhong was so scared that he did not even have time to react.

Bang!

Seeing that he was not moving, an officer went over and threw him over his shoulder, directly making him fall to the ground.

…

Chuan City Hospital.

Li Jing was lying on the hospital bed, but her face was full of smiles.

With this car accident, not only did her popularity not decline, but she also increased her popularity.

Li Jing could already see the scene of countless resources flying toward her in the future.

At this moment, her phone, which was placed beside her pillow, rang.

Li Jing looked at the caller ID, and the smile on her face widened.

This was a call from the boss of the company she had signed a contract with.

The boss was definitely calling to congratulate her on her rise in popularity!

However, as soon as Li Jing picked up the phone, a roar came from the other side.

“Li Jing, what the hell did you do?

“Just now, the contracts for your movies, TV shows, and commercials… The entire media industry has cut off all cooperation with us!

“My company’s TV shows and movies… Now, they’re all rubbish!

“Hurry up and explain this to me!”

Li Jing was dumbfounded and did not know how to explain.

At this moment, a large group of police officers suddenly rushed in from outside the door.

“Li Jing, you’re under arrest!”

…

At the same time, all the negative comments and insults about Lin Fan disappeared as if they had never appeared in the first place.

Just as many people were feeling puzzled, the People’s Daily published an article.

[Congratulations to Lin Fan of Jiangbei University for inventing an earthquake prediction device that can predict earthquakes five days in advance! This research will greatly reduce the disasters caused by earthquakes and save countless lives and property. Let us sincerely say to Lin Fan, ‘Lin Fan, you’ve worked hard. Thank you!’]
